instructions.name: graduate
docs: Atomically initializes Raydium CPMM and permanently locks all issued LP.

accounts.name: reimbursement
docs: An existing caller-owned WSOL ATA. Wallet preparation is not pool initialization.

instructions.name: claim_raydium_creator_fees
docs: Collect the net Raydium creator bucket and claim one FeeKey's 50% share.
LP-fee claims remain independent calls to the official Raydium locker.

accounts.name: fee_nft_account
docs: Current ownership, not the initial NFT recipient or a token delegate.
Emitted by a self-CPI only after the atomic graduation postconditions pass.
types.name: PoolGraduated

docs: Fresh Raydium-only immutable launch policy. No migration percentage fee or LP unlock path.
types.name: ConfigParameters

docs: Disclosed maximum actual account rent + official pool creation cost.
fields.name: max_setup_lamports

docs: Legacy minimum supply after graduation. New mainnet policies require
zero: no supply floor protects unused inventory from burning. This does
NOT mean burn holders' tokens or set actual mint supply to zero.
fields.name: post_migration_token_supply

docs: When it's exact in, partial fill, this will be amount_in. When it's exact out, this will be amount_out
fields.name: amount_0

docs: When it's exact in, partial fill, this will be minimum_amount_out. When it's exact out, this will be maximum_amount_in
fields.name: amount_1

types.name: ClaimFeeOperator
docs: Parameter that set by the protocol

fields.name: _padding
docs: v1: all zero. v2: first eight bytes are the fixed graduation revenue
in little-endian lamports; last seven remain reserved. Same account ABI.

types.name: OperationalAuthority
docs: A replaceable automation signer, not an admin, fee recipient or mint authority.
Only the existing cold-admin instructions can initialize or replace it.

types.name: RaydiumCreatorFees
docs: Lifetime amounts paid to [creator FeeKey, partner FeeKey], in token0/token1.
No close/reset instruction: unclaimed entitlement follows the current NFT.

fields.name: pool_type
docs: pool type, spl token or token2022

fields.name: leftover_amount
docs: Tracked fixed-supply leftover allocated at graduation, excluding unsolicited donations.

fields.name: graduation
docs: Written exactly once, after the official pool and both permanent locks are verified.
